subject: Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches

topics.title: Number and algebra
topics.blurb: Financial mathematics, growth and decay, sequences, numerical exponentials, logarithms and technology-assisted algebra.

topics.title: Functions
topics.blurb: Numerical roots, graph intersections, inverse values, transformations, models, rational functions and graph analysis.

topics.title: Geometry and trigonometry
topics.blurb: Coordinate methods, bearings, triangle rules, ambiguous cases, radians, 3D geometry and vectors.

topics.title: Statistics and probability
topics.blurb: Technology-based statistics, regression, binomial and normal distributions, expected value and interpretation.

topics.title: Calculus
topics.blurb: Numerical differentiation, tangents, stationary points, optimization, integration, kinematics and approximation.

howTo: Paper 2 assesses mathematical reasoning with technology available. Record the calculator operation used - such as zero, intersection, regression, normal CDF or numerical integral - and show enough setup for method marks. Do not treat calculator output as a substitute for mathematical communication.

steps.text: up Write the equation, model or probability statement before using technology.
Use graphing, statistics and numerical tools accurately.
Use exact answers where appropriate; otherwise round to three significant figures.
Answer in context with units, restrictions and sensible conclusions.
